quote: formulated by Max Dehn in 1910 in his paper 'Über die Topologie des dreidimensional Raumes'
note: The problem was formulated in Dehn's 1910 paper in Mathematische Annalen as a request for a procedure to determine if a curve is knotted. This predates formal mathematical definition of an algorithm.
